look_here_first: Start with the leaves: long stiff yucca-like linear leaves with spiny margins, topped by pale greenish-white globose heads. It lacks the vivid purple canopy and broad divided leaves of E. leavenworthii.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: no conspicuous purple terminal bract crown

lookalikes.differences: E. leavenworthii is annual, purple, and broad/divided-leaved; E. yuccifolium is perennial and yucca-leaved.

verified_photos.creator: Eric Hunt
verified_photos.role: Whole flowering habit, spiny clustered globular heads, strap-shaped basal leaves
